visual: A tangle of silver-white wiry stems · reads like silver coral
water: Moderate water · let it drain sharply
prune: Pinch the tips to bush it out · never cut into old wood
hardinessNote: Hardy only in coastal and relatively mild UK locations, approximately -5 to 1°C.
resilience: Drought tolerant and pest-free · wet winters and hard frost end it
uses: Pots · coastal and gravel gardens · bedding · silver schemes
uncertain: Frequently sold under the older synonym Calocephalus brownii. (Oscar's note.)
peak: research said "Year-round silver foliage"; converted to Jan-Dec, the band the deck already uses for year-round interest.
